changes.now: Four siblings are given powers by a dying alien, and fight crime while keeping it from their parents. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-635972 is marked terminated.
changes.proposed: Four siblings are given powers by an alien who is passing his on, and, with their parents in on the secret, settle into a new town, where Jack takes a medallion from the haunted house of Dr. Mobius and his ghost comes after the family. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-635972 is marked terminated.
changes.evidence: In the 1991 Power Pack pilot the parents know about the powers: Dr. James Power gathers his children to discuss their powers, and Wikipedia notes the pilot changed the concept so 'the children's parents [are] aware of their superhuman abilities'. There is no crime-fighting: the plot is the move to a new neighborhood, Jack stealing a medallion from Dr. Mobius's haunted mansion, and the ghost haunting the Power house until the kids return it. The narrating entity says only that it was time to pass on his powers (no on-screen death).

changes.now: Tony Stark raises an ancient temple in China and wakes the Mandarin. Captured, he builds his armor to fight the Mandarin's Elemental warriors. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-199673 is marked terminated.
changes.proposed: Tony Stark raises an ancient temple in China and wakes the Mandarin's Elemental warriors, who set out to bring him back. Captured by the Jade Dragons, he builds his armor to escape, and then goes after the Elementals. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-199673 is marked terminated.
changes.evidence: Raising the city wakes four of the Five Elementals, not the Mandarin; the Mandarin is only resurrected at the climax, through Li Mei, and then disintegrates. Tony is captured by Wong-Chu's Jade Dragons and builds the armor with Rhodey to escape them; only after that does he fight the Elementals for the rings.
